author: Tin Nguyen
description: Extend the assistant cog with Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) capabilities. Allow the assistant to answer questions based on your own documents.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores per-guild RAG configuration settings. End users can also store embeddings in the vector database for RAG purposes.
install_msg: Thank you for installing the RAG Utils cog! Configure it using `[p]help ragutils`.
